content.title: Predisposing factors for venous thromboembolism (VTE)
general_risk_factors: Immobility due to sitting (e.g. prolonged car or air travel)
strong_risk_factors_(OR_>_10): Hospitalization for heart failure or atrial fibrillation/flutter (within previous 3 months)
